strings.subtitle: — Spolem fael —
strings.no_file: I no gat fael we yu pikim
strings.dnd_hint: (o pulum fael i kam long windo ia)
strings.dnd_unavailable: Pulum mo lego i no stap. Yusum baton we i stap daun.
strings.shred_button: S P O L E M
strings.ssd_warning:
Lukaut! Long SSD, fasin blong raetem antap i no promes spel from TRIM.
Program ia i blong HDD.
strings.confirm_text:
Bae oli raetem antap long fael "{name}" mo bae oli rimuvum.

Go hed?
strings.confirm_lnk_text:
This is a shortcut (.lnk). Only the shortcut itself will be destroyed.

The target file it points to will remain intact.

Continue?
strings.drive_remote_warning:
This is a network drive (\\server\share).
Sector overwrite does not guarantee destruction — the server may have snapshots, deduplication or CoW.

Continue?
strings.drive_removable_warning:
This is a removable drive (USB stick / external HDD).
The controller may keep old blocks in reserve.

Continue?
strings.report_title: ✅  OLI RAETEM ANTAP MO RIMUVUM FAEL
strings.report_limits:
• NTFS nara data strem (ADS) i no wokem.
• Buk blong USN i no klinim.
• Kobi blong sado mo sinkronisesen blong klaod
  (OneDrive mo nara) i no afektem.
strings.step_rename: Senisim nem i go long GUID
strings.status_full: Konten i raetem antap fulwan wetem ziro. I no save kambak — tul bae luk ziro nomo.
strings.status_fast: Hed, tel mo 4 MB laen i raetem antap. Narawan i no tusem, be from ol hol, ful kambak long tul blong kastoma i no save. Blong ol privat dokument, yusum FULL moed.
strings.status_empty: Fael i empti, raetem antap i no nid. Rimuvum finis.
strings.error_permission: I no save go long fael. Ating i open long nara program. Klosem mo traem bak.
strings.error_not_found: I no faenem fael. Ating i rimuvum finis.
strings.error_unknown: Rong we i no stap tingting: {err}
strings.error_is_symlink: Hem i simbolik link. Link i no save spel — fael we link i go long hem bae i stap sef.
strings.error_reparse: Hem i fael blong ples (OneDrive o sem). Data blong hem i stap long klaod, i no long disik — i no gat samting blong spolem hia.
strings.error_not_file: Hem i no fael (folda o nara samting). Letem wan fael i foldaon.
strings.error_hardlinks: Fael ia i gat nara had link ({n} ful). Had link i no gat hed — evri nem i sem. Sapos yu spolem tru rod ia nao, data bae i raetem antap mo katem i go long 32 bait, be haf we i stap bae i save go tru nara link. Rimuvum evri link fastaem.
strings.error_compressed:
Fael i kompresem, enkraeptem o tin. Raetem antap wetem ziro i no promes spel blong olfala data from NTFS i holem ol long narafala fasin.

Rimuvum atrap: klik raet → Propoti → Advans → rimuvum mak long Kompresem mo/o Enkraeptem. Nao, ronem SHREDDER bakegen.
strings.queue_hint: (o draem ol file long windo ia)
strings.queue_confirm_text:
Bae i delit {count} file.
Olgeta saes: {size}.

Chek list ia bifo yu go hed.
Aksen ia i no save tanem bak.
strings.queue_clear_confirm_text:
Karem aot ol {count} file long kio?

Ol file ia bae i no kasem wan samting — list nomo.
strings.hardlink_text:
File "{name}" i gat ol had link ({nlink} long olgeta).

Data bae i lus long olgeta nem.
Be stubs (32 bytes) bae i stap long ol narafala nem long folda.

Yu save nidim blong delit ol stubs ia ya.
strings.hardlink_apply_all: Aplike long olgeta had link long kio
